requestedText: Schedule the approved Weekly Radar run on Monday 09:00 JST and publish only a bounded rolling archive to the dedicated data branch.

evidence: The workflow invokes the repository CLI and public sources declared by the Contract; it does not dynamically load an unbounded workflow or provider reference.
The workflow is a new repository-local scheduled entrypoint; its only external effects are the Contract-authorized Telegram delivery and data-branch update.
No existing monitoring, deployment, or workflow job is replaced; concurrency and failure guards are local safety controls for the new job.
The Contract explicitly authorizes the Monday schedule, contents:write, Telegram delivery, and data-branch rolling cleanup while prohibiting main-branch history rewrites.
